lines.en: I circle the lamp indoors.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀很薄，几乎是灰的。
lines.en: My wings are thin, nearly grey.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙飞行，避开风口。
lines.en: I fly close to the walls, out of the draught.
I settle on an old piece of clothing.
I lift off again and circle halfway.

lines.zh: 我的翅拍得很快，声音很小。
lines.en: My wings beat fast, very softly.

lines.zh: 我从窗纸的破口飞出去。
lines.en: I slip out through a tear in the paper window.
I fly along under the eaves.
I pause, then rise again.
I go toward the light.

lines.zh: 我在柜子上面绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle above the cupboard.

lines.zh: 我落回墙上，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I settle on the wall, almost invisible.
I fly low, skimming the floor.
I avoid the smoke and go around.
I skirt the lampshade to avoid the heat.
I return to that lamp again.
I rest on the wall, wings spread flat.
I am a clothes moth. My body is tiny.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯一亮，我的触角就动。
lines.en: The hallway light comes on and my antennae twitch.
This house smells of wool.
The night is my time.
By day I hide behind the furniture.
When a lamp is lit, I go to it.
I do not bite people. I look for fiber.
There are fine lines on my wings.
A breeze and I lose my grip on the wall.
I wait for the lamp to die.
When people sleep, the house is mine.

lines.zh: 我的寿命比一般蛾子长。
lines.en: I live longer than most moths.
I have nights enough.
You have seen me. That is rare.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里，翅膀不动。
lines.en: I am in your shadow, wings still.
You raise a hand and I take off.
You need not shoo me. I do not bite.

lines.zh: 你的衣服上有我喜欢的味道。
lines.en: Your clothes carry a smell I like.
I am only resting on the wall.
You come close; I shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的翅合起来了，像一片灰。
lines.en: My wings fold, and I am a fleck of grey.

lines.zh: 我只有指甲盖大，夜里贴着墙。
lines.en: No bigger than a nail, I cling to the wall at night.
The lamp is out. I am still here.
A bent wing makes my flight wobble.
I fall to the floor and flip over.
Several beats before I rise.
Some of my wing dust has come off.
I can no longer fly high.
I hide in the corner.
My antennae draw in.
I'm small. That was enough.
I can still crawl.
I crawl toward the dark.
Nectar is sweet to me.
I fly toward that flower.
I settle on the flower's heart, lightly.

lines.zh: 我一边吸一边带着花粉。
lines.en: As I drink, I carry pollen.
The flower will seed a little more for it.
This draws me more than wool.
I circle the flower twice.

lines.zh: 有花的地方我就多待一会儿。
lines.en: Where there are flowers, I linger.
Where is the next one?
I smell it. Over there.
You wave and the air pushes me away.

lines.zh: 我在半空翻了一圈才稳住。
lines.en: I tumble once before steadying.
I land on the table, a wing slightly bent.
I slowly smooth it out.

lines.zh: 你撞到柜子，我从上面飞起。
lines.en: You knock the cupboard and I take flight.

lines.zh: 我从你的袖口擦过去了。
lines.en: I brushed past your cuff.

lines.zh: 这么小的撞击，我也会怕。
lines.en: Even so small a shock frightens me.
I retreat into the dark.
My wings are intact. I can still fly.
I settle back on the same wall.
Another is on the other side of the lamp.
We circle the lamp together.
My antennae touch its own.
We rest side by side on the wall.
Its wings are paler than mine.
We will lay our eggs on a leaf.
Those eggs will become caterpillars.
The caterpillars eat only leaves.

lines.zh: 再往后就是蛹，然后又是我们。
lines.en: Then a cocoon, and then us again.
The lamp is lit. We are still flying.

lines.zh: 我落在东西上，只是歇脚。
lines.en: I land on things only to rest.
The fiber in this is fine.
I walk a few steps across it.
I taste it. Cotton.

lines.zh: 这纤维糙，我只能绕着走。
lines.en: The fiber's coarse; I just walk around it.
I take off once more.
Too heavy. I cannot carry it.

lines.zh: 我的脚只能抓住一点点。
lines.en: My feet can hold only a little.

lines.zh: 东西落下去，我也跟着下。
lines.en: It falls, and I follow it down.
I settle beside it.
Someone has lit a lamp in the house.
My wings have turned of their own accord.
Light is my direction.
I lift off and circle once.
I draw closer to the lamp.
The heat sears my wings.
I go on just the same.
I rest a moment on the shade.
Too hot. I lift off again.
The lamp is right before me.
I circle the light, closer each turn.
My shadow wheels across the wall.
I can see nothing else.
My wings beat faster.
Heat presses on my wings.
I am a hand's width from the shade.
I truly cannot stop.
I strike it and bounce away.
I come back around.
This is the third time.
I have nothing that can hurt.
I strike, and it is only a strike.
Scale dust from my wings falls on the shade.
I bounce off and spin twice.
I land on a book.
My wings are still trembling.
I try to fly once more.
I manage half a foot and come down.
I can only crawl on the floor.
Crawl toward the light.

lines.zh: 我从茧里出来，翅还是软的。
lines.en: I come out of the cocoon, wings still soft.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶子上等它们硬。
lines.en: I hang on the leaf waiting for them to harden.

lines.zh: 这里是村庄的一间屋子。
lines.en: This is a room in a village.
Wool, a lamp, people.
Exactly to my liking.
I spread my wings for the first time.
So thin they almost pass light.
I fly and bump the wall.
I hug the wall and lift off slowly.
This time I clear the beam.

lines.zh: 火一来，我的翅立刻卷曲发黑。
lines.en: Fire comes and my wings curl black.

lines.zh: 我从梁上掉下来，落地时翅摊开了。
lines.en: I drop from the beam and land with wings splayed.

lines.zh: 水把我按在下面，翅贴在身上。
lines.en: Water pins me under, wings plastered to my body.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到墙上，翅全乱了。
lines.en: The blast throws me at the wall and my wings are a mess.
An arrow passes through my wing.

lines.zh: 怪光落下来，我的翅抖个不停。
lines.en: Strange light falls and my wings will not stop shaking.

lines.zh: 太久没喝到花蜜，我飞不动了。
lines.en: Too long without nectar; I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我整只都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I am scorched all over.

lines.zh: 屋子的地面没了，我在黑里飘。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I drift through black.
